rows.text: You accidentally step into the gravitational slide of the recycling plant. Broken machines and scrapped parts swarm into a river and push you forward, falling through the chimney into a bright room.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The repairman's beard is covered in small gears and flecks of ore. He's draped in a cloak made from chilled stars, looking like a magician.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Is there something you want, child?" The old man unhurriedly puts down the plastic toy in his hands and gently shifts his turbid eyes at you. In the display case, centrifuge chambers and engine fragments and white latex are stuck together into various bizarre toys.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "You can take them if you want it. Well, you can also choose to leave something here. Trash that you no longer have any use for. I promise you that you'll be very surprised when you see them next."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Leave behind the plastic ornaments on you.
The old man waves goodbye to you with a smile, as if you were long-lost friends.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
